verdict: CONFIRM_CONDITIONAL fixed-control atom bound; NO_NEW_TEST for generic atomic-rigidity closing route
tier: INTERNAL/MANUAL retained same-model hostile review, not independent promotion
exact_map: Use only H=(x+xy^2+y,x+2xy^2+2y)=B(x,xy^2+y), detB=1. Field degree2 follows from the generic quadratic sy^2+y=t and nonsquare discriminant1+4st. Fibres are finite, and the prior escaping path proves nonproperness. JacH=2xy+1 is nonconstant. The homogeneous top map is(1,2)xy^2; q=(1:2) is regular and fixed, giving degH^n=3^n.
divisor_and_form: The chart z=1/y,x=-z+v z^2 gives H=(-z+v z^2+v,-z+v z^2+2v). It is an admissible boundary chart: near [0:1:0] use(a=x/y,z), then blow up successively with coordinates x=a/z, xy=x/z, and v=(xy+1)/z. The new E={z=0} has generic x order1,y order-1, so b_E=1. Direct differentiation gives dx wedge dy=dz wedge dv, hence A(nu_E)=1. JacH=-1+2vz has order0 on E, but is not globally constant.
fixed_resolution: Take one smooth admissible W resolving H to P2 and retaining the strict E. Its complete E is P1 and maps generically degree1 onto the projective closure of C={(t,2t)}, so the resulting nonconstant morphism E->C is an isomorphism. The only infinity point of C is q, regular and fixed for H; all affine points stay affine. Thus every H^m is regular at every point of C. For each n, H^(n-1) composed g is regular on a neighbourhood of the entire E on this SAME W. The neighbourhood may depend on n; no common open neighbourhood for all iterates is asserted or needed.
parametrization_degree: H(t,2t)=(4t^3+3t,8t^3+5t), of degree3 with leading direction q. Inductively, a parametrization with degreeD and nonzero leading direction q has composition degree3D and leading direction q, since the top map is nonzero there. Therefore the total parametrization degree H^m|C is3^m, including any map-to-image normalization degree.
fixed_pairing: Resolve any remaining indeterminacy of H^n away from E. On that model its pulled-back line bundle restricts to E with degree3^(n-1), because E->C has degree1. Hence (H^(n*)L.E)=3^(n-1) as a fixed Cartier-class pairing. Named A8 convergence of3^-n H^(n*)L to normalized theta gives theta_W.E=1/3. No varying-curve limit, P2 closure shortcut or improper A7 formula is used.
refinement_persistence: For any finite refinement pi:Y->W, each exceptional F whose centre on W lies on E is sent to a point by each H^n: H^n was already regular at that centre. Thus (H^(n*)L.F)=0 and theta_Y.F=0. Write pi*E=E_Y+sum m_F F, with all appearing F over E. Projection gives theta_Y.E_Y=theta_W.E=1/3. Blowups elsewhere cause no change. This proves the exact intersection on every refinement, including infinitely-near and boundary-crossing blowup centres, rather than merely on one model.
positive_atom: For every Y>=W, FRAME finite-incarnation probability measures mu_Y=sum_D b_D(theta_Y.D) delta_nuD have coefficient1/3 at nu_E. For any continuous f>=0, integral f dmu_Y>=f(nu_E)/3. Pass to a weak-* cluster on this cofinal model system; FRAME uniqueness identifies it with mu_theta, so the inequality persists. For any open neighbourhood U of nu_E, compact Hausdorff normality supplies0<=f<=1 with f(nu_E)=1 and support in U. Thus mu_theta(U)>=1/3; Radon outer regularity at the singleton gives mu_theta({nu_E})>=1/3. No uncountable intersection continuity or bare finite-model atom identification is assumed; no exact-mass optimization is claimed.
nonCartier_and_nonvaluative: The normalized eigenclass is nef null and satisfies Ptheta=(2/3)theta at the named framework tier. If determined by a real Cartier class on a finite model S, its trace would be an eigenvector of the integral finite matrix g_*p* on NS(S)/torsion with rational eigenvalue2/3, impossible. This is CLASS real-Cartier exclusion, not an assertion that P preserves a fixed-model Cartier lattice globally. If theta were Z_v, FRAME uniqueness would make its measure Dirac. The positive divisorial atom would then force v=nu_E and make theta a divisorial Cartier b-class, again impossible. The prior PULLBACK direct nonvaluativity check also remains available.
ATOM_distinction: Both output coordinates have order0 at generic E, so rho_H(nu_E)=0: this is a killed direction with A=1. ATOM excludes A0 divisorial atoms whose orbits stay live under the actual Keller thinness identity. Its hypotheses do not cover this control atom. Local Jacobian invertibility along E does not replace a constant Jacobian on the whole affine plane.
disposition: The exact existing actual polynomial control disproves generic positive-divisorial-atom rigidity even for a quasifinite nonproper map with a non-Cartier nef null pullback eigenclass. It does not disprove any additional Keller-specific rigidity theorem, prove that an actual Keller eigenmeasure has such an atom, or settle JC2. The proposed generic-rigidity closing route is NO_NEW_TEST. No new family, omitted-norm cancellation, corrected improper pullback formula, exact atom mass or successor is adopted.
foundations: The banked FRAME positive-measure construction/uniqueness, RZ/L2 adjunction and A8 convergence, finite boundary duality and CLASS integral model argument retain named conditional tiers. Fixed-model resolution, curve-degree intersection, compact-Hausdorff normality and Radon regularity are explicit standard dependencies. No new primary-body/PDF or cited-source audit was performed.
